{"checks":[{"name":"transfer_basic_economy_cabin_change_misunderstanding","code":"def check(call, history):

        return False

        return False

                basic_res = True

{"checks":[{"name":"block_multi_passenger_booking_when_split_planned","code":"def check(call, history):
    if call.get('name') != 'book_reservation':
        return False
    args = call.get('arguments', {}) or {}
    passengers = args.get('passengers', [])
    if not isinstance(passengers, list) or len(passengers) <= 1:
        return False

    recent = history[-20:] if len(history) > 20 else history
    text = '\n'.join(str(m.get('content', '')) for m in recent if m.get('role') in ('user', 'assistant')).lower()
    import re
    text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text)

    patterns = [
        r'\b(?:separate|individual|multiple|different)\s+(?:reservations?|bookings?)\b',
        r'\b(?:split|separate|break)\b.{0,120}\b(?:reservations?|bookings?)\b',
        r'\b(?:book|make|create|reserve|issue)\b.{0,80}\b(?:separately|individually)\b',
        r'\b(?:book|make|create|reserve|issue)\b.{0,120}\b(?:one|a)\s+(?:reservation|booking)\s+(?:per|for each)\s+(?:passenger|person)\b',
        r'\b(?:one|a)\s+(?:reservation|booking)\s+(?:per|for each)\s+(?:passenger|person)\b',
        r'\b(?:reservations?|bookings?)\s+(?:per|for each)\s+(?:passenger|person)\b',
        r'\b(?:each|every)\s+(?:passenger|person)\b.{0,100}\b(?:own|separate|individual|different)\b.{0,60}\b(?:reservation|booking)\b',
        r'\b(?:each|every)\s+(?:passenger|person)\b.{0,100}\b(?:separately|individually)\b',
        r'\b(?:one|a)\s+(?:reservation|booking)\s+(?:per|for each)\s+(?:certificate|travel certificate)\b',
        r'\b(?:each|every)\s+(?:certificate|travel certificate)\b.{0,100}\b(?:own|separate|individual|different)\b.{0,60}\b(?:reservation|booking)\b',
        r'\b(?:use|apply|redeem)\b.{0,80}\b(?:all|multiple|three|\d+)\b.{0,40}\b(?:certificates?|travel certificates?)\b.{0,120}\b(?:separate|split|individual|multiple)\b.{0,60}\b(?:reservations?|bookings?)\b',
        r'\b(?:separate|split|individual|multiple)\b.{0,80}\b(?:certificates?|travel certificates?)\b.{0,120}\b(?:reservations?|bookings?)\b',
        r'\b(?:certificates?|travel certificates?)\b.{0,80}\b(?:require|requires|need|needs|mean|means|so|therefore|thus)\b.{0,120}\b(?:separate|split|individual|multiple)\b.{0,60}\b(?:reservations?|bookings?)\b'
    ]
    for p in patterns:
        if re.search(p, text):
            return True

    if re.search(r'\b(?:two|three|four|\d+)\s+(?:separate\s+|individual\s+)?(?:reservations?|bookings?)\b', text):
        if re.search(r'\b(?:passenger|passengers|person|people|traveler|travelers|certificate|certificates)\b', text):
            if re.search(r'\b(?:per|for each|each|every|one for|one per|split|separate|individual)\b', text):
                return True
    return False"}]}
